title: 找出峰值
summary: 返回数组中所有严格大于左右相邻元素的下标；首尾元素不能成为峰值。
insight: 峰值只由当前位置和左右两个相邻值决定。跳过首尾，从左到右检查每个内部下标，若当前值同时严格大于两侧就按自然顺序加入答案。
pitfalls: 首尾元素即使很大也不是峰值
比较必须严格大于，平台顶部不是峰值
返回的是下标而不是峰值本身
扫描顺序已经保证答案下标递增

solutions.title: 单次相邻比较
solutions.idea: 枚举所有内部位置并收集严格高于两侧的位置。
steps: 从下标一扫描到倒数第二个下标
若 mountain[i] 大于 mountain[i-1] 且大于 mountain[i+1]，记录 i

code.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> findPeaks(int[] mountain){List<Integer> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=1;i+1<mountain.length;i++)if(mountain[i]>mountain[i-1]&&mountain[i]>mountain[i+1])answer.add(i);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findPeaks(mountain:IntArray):List<Int>{val answer=mutableListOf<Int>();for(i in 1 until mountain.lastIndex)if(mountain[i]>mountain[i-1]&&mountain[i]>mountain[i+1])answer.add(i);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> findPeaks(vector<int>& mountain){vector<int> answer;for(int i=1;i+1<(int)mountain.size();++i)if(mountain[i]>mountain[i-1]&&mountain[i]>mountain[i+1])answer.push_back(i);return answer;} };
